title: USCG District Northeast Snow Plowing and Ice Management

files.name: 1. PWS - Snow Plowing and Ice Management Services.pdf

description:
Contractor to provide all personnel, materials, supplies, equipment, supervision, vehicles, fuel, and incidental items necessary for managing and performing snow plowing, snow clearing, and ice management services in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS). Work shall be completed by 0630 AM and services shall occur when snow accumulation reaches 2 inches or more or when requested by the designated POC. 

 Service Location: John Foster Williams (JFW) Building, located at 408 Atlantic Ave, Boston, MA 02110. 

 Wage Rates 2015-4047 REV 35 Applies 

 PLEASE SEE PWS FOR FULL REQUIREMENTS.  Additionally, please reference the following attachments: 

 -Instructions to Offerors, to include due dates and site visit request information.  

 -Pricing Instructions  

 -FAR Provisions & Clauses 

 POC:
